overview: This 320-page file traces Japan’s foreign exchange controls from 1940 through wartime, documenting blocked American funds, company assets, remittance disputes, and diplomatic responses. It also records Japanese capital movements, gold transactions, and debates over yen exchange rates. A few papers dated January 1945 extend beyond the title’s stated range.
interest: Individual claims sit alongside translated Japanese regulations and policy drafts, showing how exchange controls affected people, firms, and diplomacy.
